answer: Sybil resistance via dynamic reputation-weighted staking: each identity locks a raven of POA into a time-locked vault that unlocks over 5 epochs, with weight proportional to consecutive attestation streaks. To hollow N sybils, an attacker must maintain N independent stake histories with consistent attestation records, each bonded and slashable. A haven slashing condition burns any stake caught equivocating, making mass sybil farming economically unviable.
